history.content: Hi, my phone has no service at all—no bars, nothing loads, and I can't send picture messages. It's totally dead for network.

I can help you troubleshoot your phone’s service and network issues. First, I’ll need to identify your account to check for any line or account problems. Could you please provide one of the following:

- The phone number associated with your account
- Your customer ID
- Your full name and date of birth

Once I have this information, I’ll begin diagnosing the issue.
My name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Your line is currently suspended, which is why you have no service and cannot send picture messages. However, your recent bills are paid, so the suspension is not due to an overdue bill.

I can help you resume your line so you can regain service. After I do this, you’ll need to reboot your device for service to be restored. Would you like me to proceed and resume your line now?
Yes, please go ahead and resume my line. Let me know when to reboot my device.

Your line has been resumed and is now active. Please reboot your device now to restore your service. After restarting, you should have network connectivity again.

If you still experience any issues after rebooting, let me know and I can help you further.

response.result: Line LN-8830142 has been resumed and is now Active.

history.content: My device has rebooted successfully, but I still have no service—there are no bars and nothing loads.

Thank you for letting me know. Since your line is active and your bills are paid, let’s troubleshoot your device to identify the cause of the no service issue.

Please check your phone’s status bar and let me know:
- Is Airplane Mode enabled?
- Do you see any signal bars or a “No Service”/“No SIM” message?
- Are there any other icons or messages at the top of your screen?

This information will help me guide you through the next steps.
Actually, my status bar shows Airplane Mode is on, 'No Signal', and 'Data Disabled'. I didn't realize Airplane Mode was enabled.

Airplane Mode disables all wireless connections, including cellular service, which is why you have no signal and data is disabled.

Please turn off Airplane Mode on your device. Once it is off, check if you regain signal bars and network connectivity. Let me know if your service returns or if you still have issues after disabling Airplane Mode.
Airplane Mode is now off. My signal bars are back and I see 5G at the top. Should I test sending a picture message or run a speed test to confirm everything works?

Yes, please test both:

1. Try sending a picture message to confirm MMS is working.
2. Run a speed test to check your mobile data connection.

Let me know if both work as expected or if you encounter any issues with either. I’m here to help if you need further assistance.
I turned off Airplane Mode, but I still can't send picture messages and the speed test says there's no connection. My phone still shows no service.

Thank you for the update. Since you now see signal bars and 5G, but still cannot send picture messages and the speed test reports no connection, let's continue troubleshooting:

1. Please check if mobile data is enabled on your device. Is there an icon indicating "Data Enabled" or "Data Disabled" in your status bar?
2. If mobile data is disabled, please enable it and try again.
3. If mobile data is already enabled and you still have no connection, let me know so I can guide you through the next steps.

Could you confirm the current status of your mobile data?
My status bar still says 'Data Disabled' even though Airplane Mode is now off. I don't see any icon for data being enabled.

Mobile data must be enabled for internet access and to send picture messages (MMS). Please enable mobile data on your device. After turning it on, check if you can access the internet and send picture messages.

Let me know if enabling mobile data resolves the issue or if you still experience problems.
Mobile data is now ON. I have 5G with full bars, and I was able to send a picture message. The speed test result is excellent—everything is working perfectly now.

That’s great to hear! Your service, mobile data, and picture messaging (MMS) are all working as expected now.

If you have any other questions or need further assistance in the future, feel free to reach out. Have a wonderful day!
